name: Old Propeller
effect: Baseline propeller; the comparison table starts at 0 max angular speed, so any upgrade is a real handling gain.

name: Standard Engine
effect: 600 forward / 200 backward speed, 120–140 acceleration in the demo's module data. Starts installed; remove and store it before fitting the Upgraded Engine. Repaired with 3× Rusty Scrap Metal.

name: Hull Protection
effect: Protection 2, Boat Speed −1. Installs in the side-front mounting slot. Required for the main route to The Throat.
requirements: Craft at John's Lathe in the Dry Dock after researching Weak Hull Protection; check the storage locker if it does not appear in inventory.

name: Afterburner
effect: A burst of speed for escapes. Optional in the demo; higher tiers are locked.

name: Fuel Tank
effect: Cheap insurance against running dry between islands. The cheapest module in the tree.

name: Upgraded Engine
cost: Carburetor costs 50 at Betsy and Sons (unlocked by the 3-Harpooner contract)
effect: Raises boat speed from 2 kn to 4 kn (750 forward / 250 backward in module data). Required for the main route.
requirements: Deliver three Harpooners to Gill and Bozur, buy the Carburetor from the shop, then craft at the Dry Dock and install in the empty engine mount.

name: Spotlight
effect: Lights up night water. Useful but expensive — it competes with hull work for Chromatic Scales.

name: Small Fish Hold
effect: More hold capacity for long fishing trips. Competes directly with hull and bait work for materials.

name: Upgraded Propeller
effect: Max angular speed 15 / acceleration 15 / deceleration 5, up from 0 on the Old Propeller. The first real handling upgrade.

name: Heavy-Duty Engine
effect: 850 forward / 250 backward speed, 160–110 acceleration. A straight power gain over the Upgraded Engine for long outer-channel runs. Repaired with 3× Rusty Scrap Metal.

name: Afterburner (Tier 6)
effect: The higher-tier burst-speed node available in the demo build.
